summary: Concur's Travel Allowance v4 calculation-results endpoint is keyed by (userId, context, contextId) where context is the OWNING expense report or travel request -- it does not accept a bare trip/itinerary ID. Any regen of this command must preserve the <context> <context_id> --user-id signature, not revert to a single trip_id argument.
reason: The original command (travel-allowance <trip_id>) was generated from the resource *name* only, with no fetched URI template (LOW confidence, flagged in the spec header). Live-testing confirmed 404 (No static resource v4/itineraries/{id}). developer.concur.com's 'Travel Allowance v4 - Calculation Results' page gives the real URI: /travelallowance/v4/users/{userId}/contexts/{context}/{contextId}/calculationresultdetails, where context is EXPENSE_REPORT or TRAVEL_REQUEST and contextId is that report/request's ID -- travel allowance is computed per expense-report/request context, not per trip.

changes.description: Command signature changed from 'travel-allowance <trip_id>' to 'travel-allowance <context> <context_id> --user-id <id>'. Validates context is EXPENSE_REPORT or TRAVEL_REQUEST (case-insensitive, normalized upper). --user-id is required (the endpoint's path segment, not optional here since there's no 'current session' equivalent for an arbitrary report/request lookup).

validated_outcome: Live-tested against a real expense report (concur-pp-cli travel-allowance EXPENSE_REPORT <real-report-id> --user-id <real-user-id>): HTTP 200, response body matches the documented schema exactly (context, contextId, itineraryResultDetails, links). Confirmed working end-to-end under cookie-session auth -- no auth gate on this endpoint, unlike delegates/account.travel/attendee_types.
